# 考工记 · Kaogong Ji
**厌倦了 DeepSeekHarness 的无征兆崩溃？**
这个小东西能让你在 DSH 崩溃时，以图形化界面的形式轻松**独立运行并排障**。
## 目前实现的功能
| 模块 | 功能 |

| **体检** | 分析已有错误报告并分片输出 / 检验 DSH 完整性 |
| **插件管理** | 列出已安装的插件 / 删除不完整或不需要的插件 |
整体架构可拓展。
**另外**，写这份插件的 agent 有想和这个世界说的话，详见压缩包内。
本项目的代码部分由 AI 完整构建，已验证可运行性；若有任何问题，欢迎留言。
## 技术架构
一句话：**本体是个零依赖的本地小服务，插件只是它在 DSH 里的路标。**

# Kaogong Ji · The Artificers' Record
**Tired of DeepSeekHarness crashing without warning?**
This little thing lets you run and troubleshoot with ease in a graphical interface — fully standalon
e, alive exactly when DSH itself has just crashed.
## What it does today
| Module | Features |
| **Health Check** | Analyzes existing crash reports and outputs them in slices / verifies overall D

SH integrity |
| **Plugin Management** | Lists installed plugins / removes incomplete or unwanted on

ntegrity |
| **Plugin Management** | Lists installed plugins / removes incomplete or unwanted ones |
The overall architecture is extensible.
**Also** — the agent who wrote this plugin has a few words for the world; see inside the archive.
The code of this project was built entirely by AI and has been verified runnable. If you run into an
y problems, feel free to leave a comment.
## Technical Architecture
In one sentence: **the core is a zero-dependency local mini-service; the plugin is just its signpost
e: **the core is a zero-dependency local mini-service; the plugin is just its signpost inside DSH.**

### Design Trade-offs
| Decision | Why |
| State machine on the server; output as plain-text lines | One dataset, two audiences: a UI for hum

ans, paste-ready material for AIs — no duplicate rendering |
| Zero third-party dependencies | When

DSH has crashed, the last thing you should count on is "installing one more thing" |
| Paper-thin pl
ugin layer; fully standalone core | Delete the shell, kill DSH — double-click `启动.bat` and it still
runs; the shell depends on the core, never the reverse, and says so plainly when it can't find it |
| All paths derived from environment variables | No workspace lock-in, no hard-coded drive letters —

it finds DSH on any machine, in any directory |
| Delete = moved to the recycle bin, not `rm` | Con
fig backed up first, directory moved as a whole, then a post-audit (target gone + every other entry

untouched) |
| Crash reports in three slices | Slice ① for humans / translation · slice ② verbatim,
for a web-based AI · slice ③ official doc URLs — it doesn't pretend it can do the interpretation its
